_comment: Hand-authored input for the committed example run (docs/examples §Task 14). Normally `claimrot ingest` produces this file's content automatically, by sending each fact pack's prose claims to Claude for reduction to {field, op, value, unit, anchor}. This machine has no Anthropic API credential, so these four assertions were transcribed by hand instead, directly from the real page structure recorded in docs/probes/2026-08-17-scraper-studio.md and re-confirmed with a live `bdata scraper run` on 2026-08-17. Everything downstream of this file — the collector call, the engine, scoring, resolution, and the report — is the real, unmodified pipeline; see examples/produce-output.ts.
